description: A route copies the complete inbound header collection and hands it to a fetch whose URL authority it replaces. That affirmative cross-host relation reports because Cookie and Authorization remain in the collection. The two near misses encode both boundaries: forwarding the same collection to the request's own host is silent, and changing host after explicitly removing both credential-bearing headers is silent.

expected.note: new Headers(request.headers) copies ambient credentials and the URL's hostname is affirmatively replaced before fetch
